title: Mixed Event — Play That Beautiful Sound! — Episode7 Beautiful Sound

meta.Event Outline: Having surpassed RAD WEEKEND, life has been quiet for Toya. Just when he feels like trying something new, the owner of an instrument store who he owes a lot to asks him to deal with customers at an event!

rows.Line: Wind Instrument Booth
se_event_beautifulsound_2024_016
se_event_beautifulsound_2024_016

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: There! Right there.

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: Oh, it's starting to sound a lot better...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, you're right.
Try doing that again for me.

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: O-Okay!

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: I get it now. I wasn't able to play the way I wanted because I was so focused on “playing properly”...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
That seems to be the case...
But you should be able to play just fine now.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: You can do it...!

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: Thanks...!

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: *Inhale*
se_event_beautifulsound_2024_015

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: *Gasp*

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, that sounded really good just now!

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line:
Hehe...!
L-Let me do that again...
se_event_beautifulsound_2024_014

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line:
I did it...!
I can make sounds using just the mouthpiece now!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: If you can produce this much sound, then you should be able to play the trumpet just fine after reattaching it.

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: Oh, you think so?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, as long as you remember this sensation. Would you like to give it a try?

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line:
Y-Yeah...!
Please let me try!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Okay.
Then, we'll reattach your mouthpiece to the trumpet and...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You should be able to play just fine now.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Try to stay relaxed.
Believe in yourself...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Hold the love you have for the sound of the trumpet in your heart, and play.

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: O-Okay...!

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: Breathe in... Breathe out...

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line:
I'm going to succeed.
I'm going to play...

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
D-Did you hear that...?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes...!
I heard it clearly!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That was a very beautiful sound.

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: I...! I did it...!

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: Thank you so much...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wow! You're playing like a pro now!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Congratulations.
That was beautiful.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: *Nod*

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm so glad you were able to play it.

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line:
Me too! And thank you two so much!
I definitely wouldn't have been able to if you hadn't brought me over here!

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: I'm going to remember what happened today for the rest of my life!

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line:
I'm going to keep practicing...
And perform in a concert someday!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That's wonderful.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'll be looking forward to that day.

rows.Speaker: Marching Band Boys
rows.Line:
Hey!
We all have to meet back up now!

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line:
Oh! Hey, you guys!
Guess what?! I can play the trumpet for real now!

rows.Speaker: Marching Band Boys
rows.Line:
Wait, was that you playing just now?!
That's awesome!

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line:
Hehe!
I'm definitely going to play with you guys during our next concert!

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line:
Anyway, everyone!
Thank you all very much!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You're welcome.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I wasn't sure what was gonna happen at first, but I'm so glad things ended up working out!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Me too.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm so glad that I was able to help him.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Thank you both very much.
You two really saved the day for us.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, also...
I'm really sorry about just demoing the instruments without actually making any purchases.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
No, that's okay.
After all, this convention is about getting people interested in playing musical instruments. So, I really appreciate you for bringing him over.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank you for giving me this wonderful opportunity.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I felt genuine joy when he figured out how to play the trumpet the way he wanted.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: The way his eyes glittered reminded me of...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: How thrilled I was the first time I ever touched a piano.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And the first time I was able to play beautiful music using my own two hands.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I also know that feeling.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You do?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Because I also felt that incredible thrill when I played my dad's keyboard for the first time.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I still remember that sound vividly.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Each note seemed to sparkle and shine...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I hope that boy looks back upon this day in a similar manner.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, so do I.

rows.Speaker: Announcement
rows.Line: <We regret to inform all our attendees that Shibuya Instrument Day will be coming to a close momentarily.>

rows.Speaker: Announcement
rows.Line: <We thank you all very much for visiting. Please make sure not to forget any of your belongings.>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Whoa, look at the time!
We gotta start packing up.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, that's right. You two need to keep working after this.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Then, we'll excuse ourselves here.
Thank you both again for helping us today.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
No, it was our pleasure.
I'm glad we got this chance to talk.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I hope we meet again soon.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Us too.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Thanks for visiting!
Get home safe, you two!
